summary:
Of twenty headline theorems, the record tells 18 exactly; one gives only a slogan, one leaves its premises in `hypotheses` unpointed. The chapter tells 15 exactly. Its four says-more: three put a sibling theorem's claim under the headline's name (in two the sibling's claim is also wider than its Lean: counting weights only; a positive start), one drops a small premise. Docstrings are weakest: 9 exact, 1 absent, 3 vaguer, 7 drop a premise that sits in the signature or section below (balance three times). No telling was false of its own statement. All three agree in 8 of 20.

Not shown: proofs were not read; definitions only as far as each statement needed; one declaration per record, so siblings were seen in passing; Chinese tellings not judged; whether the Lean says what is meant; whether twenty stand for 537. Verdicts on premises stated nearby rest on judgment, marked in each note.
